_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallets" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "balance" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wallet', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'circle', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "photos" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("category_id", "month", "year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subscriptions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "cycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "next_billing" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credit-card', "note" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayers" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prayer" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ontime', "qobliyah" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("qobliyah" IN (0, 1)), "badiyah" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("badiyah" IN (0, 1)), "rakaat" INTEGER NULL, "prayed_at" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("date", "prayer"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NULL, "systolic" INTEGER NULL, "diastolic" INTEGER NULL, "pulse" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NULL, "photo_url" TEXT NULL, "local_photo_path" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_areas" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#58CC02', "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'briefcase', "schedule" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "bucket" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'want', "due_date" TEXT NULL, "due_time" TEXT NULL, "remind_before" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "done_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "amount" REAL NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "checklist" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "labels" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "color" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "photos" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "audio" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "links" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "source" TEXT NULL, "linked_task_id" TEXT NULL, "linked_content_id" TEXT NULL, "linked_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_labels" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#58CC02', "pinned_tab" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned_tab" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "social_accounts" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_name" TEXT NULL, "handle" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_per_week" INTEGER NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_items" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ide', "format" TEXT NULL, "pillar" TEXT NULL, "idea" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note_id" TEXT NULL, "checklist" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "photos" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "asset_links" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sponsor" TEXT NULL, "stage_log" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_posts" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "hashtags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scheduled_at" INTEGER NULL, "remind_before" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "posted_at" INTEGER NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "metrics" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "metrics_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_pillars" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#58CC02', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#58CC02', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'build', "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"type":"daily"}', "target" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"type":"check"}', "reminders" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), "why" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_logs" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "triggers" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("habit_id", "date", "type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "price_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "manual_price" REAL NULL, "manual_price_at" INTEGER NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lembar', "wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_trades" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NULL, "price" REAL NULL, "fee" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "amount" REAL NULL, "ratio" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "cash_transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cached_prices" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" REAL NOT NULL, "prev_close" REAL NULL, "change" REAL NULL, "change_pct" REAL NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDR', "name" TEXT NULL, "as_of" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "stale" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stale" IN (0, 1)), "cached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portfolio_snapshots" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "cost" REAL NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NULL, "base" TEXT NULL, "is_create" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_create" IN (0, 1)), "in_flight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_flight" IN (0, 1)), "client_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "epoch" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "full_pull_required" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("full_pull_required" IN (0, 1)), "tasks_seeded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tasks_seeded" IN (0, 1)), "notes_seeded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notes_seeded" IN (0, 1)), "content_seeded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("content_seeded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_date ON transactions (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_wallet ON transactions (wallet_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_to_wallet ON transactions (to_wallet_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tx_category ON transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_budget_period ON budgets (year, month)
CREATE INDEX idx_planned_date ON planned (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_health_date ON health (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_date ON food (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_task_area ON tasks (area_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_task_due ON tasks (due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_note_updated ON notes (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_post_content ON content_posts (content_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_post_account ON content_posts (account_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_post_scheduled ON content_posts (scheduled_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_habit_log_habit ON habit_logs (habit_id, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_habit_log_date ON habit_logs (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_asset_symbol ON assets (kind, symbol)
CREATE INDEX idx_trade_asset ON asset_trades (asset_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_trade_cash_tx ON asset_trades (cash_transaction_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_entity ON outbox (entity, entity_id)
